propositions: When close-gate verification fails due to evidence search budget exhaustion without refuting any criterion, the gate should automatically re-run the verifier instead of failing to the operator

The resumption loop must reuse the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to qualify only FAILs where all unmet criteria carry the evidence_sufficient:false marker, ensuring genuine refutations fail fast without resumption

Resumptions are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2, 0 disables) and gated by strict progress—a new attempt dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count
The resumption seam is at close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping the llm.verify_completion call, ensuring CLI, MCP, and library close paths all exercise the shared gate

Per-attempt metadata (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet count) is recorded on the verdict sidecar and visible in close output, with refusal message stating the resumption count and per-attempt breakdown
